judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core runtime logic in `ToolRegistry` using `ajv` (`compileSchema`, `WeakMap` caching, and non-leaking error formatting) and includes acceptance tests covering several key scenarios. However, the candidate appears to have stopped partway through its own Definition of Done, leaving `.lore/dod.md` committed in the repository and `specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md` marked `In Progress` with several unlinked bullets. It is missing multiple required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property passthrough, dynamic schema changes, static schema compiled once, unknown tool throw) and the test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Furthermore, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) were made, and `CHANGELOG.md` only mentions `register` rather than `execute` validation and the migration note.
